comments.author: Erda
comments.body: You can purchase this from French colonies. Can it be procured or collected as well?

comments.author: Emma
comments.body: English colonies too. Maybe all North American colonies.

comments.author: Nina
comments.body: can be bought on any colony w good development and population

comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: You can get it any colony that has the numbers for it, and doesn't have any other NA local good that replaces it (colonies can have only 2 NA local goods at any time)

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: It's a pretty common trade good in company colonies, I think second most common among north america specialities after cranberries. I'd think if you register three random colonies you'll probably find it in one, likely two, conceivably all three.

comments.author: Alienor
comments.body:
The prerequisites for maple syrup are not good.
In my colony it appeared after I added a planted forest and an R1 mine. Since I wasn't after him, I didn't dig any further.
What is certain, however, is that 1100 points in Agriculture is not a sufficient condition for it to appear.
